name: State Mountaineering Reward Scheme
benefit: A cash award of ₹25,000/-, a memento, and a certificate will be awarded to each of the adventurers of the state every year for their outstanding achievements in the field of mountaineering.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a native of Gujarat. - The applicant should have climbed a height of 7,000 meters once or a height of more than 6,000 meters twice. - The climbing achievement of the applicant must be confirmed by the Director of the Indian Mountaineering Foundation (IMF). - The applicant should not be involved in any criminal activity. ****This award can also be given posthumously, for which the legal heir of the awardee will have to apply.***
